scope: Additive immutable Core level evidence for six Equipment items from previously hash-pinned official tables; no Equipment combat effect is enabled.
game_version: Official August 2024 and January 2025 balance announcements; exact September 2026 client continuity and effect timing unverified.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official Traditional Chinese page explicitly prints before-and-after Royal Gem DPS and HP increase for every level 1-18; the English version of the same announcement omits the tables.
Its post-buff HP sequence is 60-570 and DPS sequence is 35-120, matching all 18 retained catalogue rows.
sources.limitations: This is an announced February 2025 balance table. It does not define when a bonus enters the battle, whether and how both equipped items' bonuses stack, maximum/current HP conversion, damage-per-hit rounding, or the active heal event.

sources.title: 關於9月平衡性調整即將上線的公告！ (Announcement of Upcoming September Balance Changes!)
facts: The September balance note explicitly increases the effect radius from six to eight tiles at all levels.
Its L9-18 post-change damage table is a historical predecessor to the later February 2025 nerf.
sources.limitations: The note gives tile units, not the center, target hitbox, footprint intersection, edge inclusion, activation sample time or tick order.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The prose says building damage is reduced and the level table gives post-change damage of 34%, 36%, 38% and 40% for L9-18 bands.
The active ability no longer affects Skeleton Trap skeletons in this announced update.
sources.limitations: The table does not cover L1-8, Wall damage, damage against ground troops, damage arithmetic or the status of the Skeleton Trap exception after February 2026.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
facts: The Earthquake Spell's new ground-troop damage behavior explicitly affects Earthquake Boots.
sources.limitations: The note supplies no ground-troop percentage, target exceptions, Wall formula or tick order.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official Traditional Chinese table prints before-and-after DPS bonuses for each Vampstache level; all 18 post-buff values match the retained normalized records.
sources.limitations: It does not print heal-per-hit, attack-speed increase, healing event, cadence arithmetic or modifier stacking.

sources.title: 關於9月平衡性調整即將上線的公告！ (Announcement of Upcoming September Balance Changes!)
facts: All-level summoned Barbarian Rage duration increased from 10 to 20 seconds.
All-level summon rate was specified as five units every 0.5 seconds.
sources.limitations: It gives no initial spawn delay, final partial batch, total count, child level, placement, collision, target choice or same-tick phase. Its L13-18 HP table predates the February 2025 buff.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official post-buff table prints an HP increase and HP recovery for every equipment level; all 18 pairs match retained normalized fields.
sources.limitations: The table does not define whether the HP increase changes current HP at deployment, activation recovery phase, cap, or stacking with a second Equipment item.

sources.title: 關於9月平衡性調整即將上線的公告！ (Announcement of Upcoming September Balance Changes!)
facts: The September 2024 note introduces five summoned Archers every one second at all Equipment levels and prints post-change invisibility duration for L1-18.
sources.limitations: It does not give the first spawn phase, current total count, child level, formation, collision, invisibility start/end tick or target-loss semantics.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The post-buff table prints Queen DPS increase and HP recovery for each L1-18 Equipment level; every pair matches the retained normalized records.
sources.limitations: The table does not define DPS-to-hit arithmetic, deployment/activation phase, recovery cap or same-tick damage/death order.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official Traditional Chinese table gives post-nerf aura DPS at every level and self-healing per second, including unchanged L1-14 rows and reduced L15-27 rows.
All 27 pairs match the retained normalized catalogue fields.
sources.limitations: No radius, pulse interval, per-pulse damage, fractional rounding, healing accumulation, target classes or activation/death tick order is specified.
